==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L23066}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|fyry}}, from {{m|enm|fyr||fire}}, equivalent to {{af|en|fire|-y|id2=adjectival}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfaɪəɹi/|/ˈfaɪɹi/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Back ache-fiery.wav}}
* {{homophones|en|firey}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪəɹi|s=3}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|more,er}}

# Of or relating to [[fire]].
# {{U|burning}} or [[glowing]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=w:Edwin Black
|chapter=1|title=[http://openlibrary.org/works/OL4103950W Internal Combustion]
|passage=Blast after blast, '''fiery''' outbreak after '''fiery''' outbreak, like a flaming barrage from within,{{...}}most of Edison's grounds soon became an inferno.  As though on an incendiary rampage, the fires systematically devoured the contents of Edison's headquarters and facilities.}}
# {{U|inflammable}} or easily [[ignite]]d.
# Having the [[colour]] of fire.
# {{U|hot}} or [[inflamed]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1892|author=w:James Yoxall
|chapter=5|title=[http://openlibrary.org/works/OL10504990W The Lonely Pyramid]
|passage=The desert storm was riding in its strength; the travellers lay beneath the mastery of the fell simoom.{{...}}Drifts of yellow vapour, '''fiery''', parching, stinging, filled the air.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|date=2017-07-12|author=Sanjiv Khamgaonkar|title=40 Mumbai foods we can’t live without|url=https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/mumbai-food-dishes/index.html|passage=A couple of vegetables, sambar (spicy and sour lentils and vegetables boiled with masalas and spices), rasam (a hot and '''fiery''' lentil soup-like dish) and curds (yoghurt) served with heaps of rice and eaten in that order. A non-vegetarian version of the “meals” can be found in “Military” hotels.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230113122546/https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/mumbai-food-dishes/index.html|archivedate=13 January 2023}}
# {{senseid|en|emotionally volatile}} {{U|tempestuous}} or [[emotionally]] [[volatile]]; [[sulfurous]].
#: {{ux|en|a '''fiery''' temper}}
# {{U|spirited}} or filled with [[emotion]].
# {{lb|en|butchery}} Having the capillaries contracted due to stress at time of slaughter, causing blood to not drain properly.
